feeds.title: Ruby Rose Sews » Sustainability
feeds.description: I'm Ruby, I work as a Studio Manager and Photographer in my everyday life. But in my spare time, I like to sew and learn about sustainability, an ever evolving passion. I'm trying to be more sustainable with my fashion and lifestyle choices, and sewing is the perfect way to do this. This blog is here to document my learning experiences.

feeds.title: Megan Nielsen Patterns Blog » Sustainable Sewing
feeds.description: We believe that creating a stylish wardrobe should be easy, and we're here to help you do it. Whether you're looking for free sew along and tutorials to update your wardrobe, styling ideas, or improve your sewing skills, you can find it all here

feeds.title: Sew Pomona
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Rebecca, artist, seamstress & beginning natural dye artisan. Follow my sewing adventures as I craft a beautiful, sustainable and eco-friendly wardrobe for myself and my family.
